"""Unit tests for baselines.RandomPlayer."""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from rllab.baselines import RandomPlayer
from rllab.core import Transition

OBS = np.zeros((1, 11), dtype=np.float32)


def _actions(player: RandomPlayer, n: int, *, explore: bool = True) -> list[int]:
    return [int(player.act(OBS, explore=explore)[0]) for _ in range(n)]


def test_one_int64_action_per_agent():
    action = RandomPlayer(4, seed=1).act(np.zeros((3, 11), dtype=np.float32), explore=False)
    assert action.shape == (3,)
    assert action.dtype == np.int64
    assert np.all((action >= 0) & (action < 4))


def test_explore_does_not_change_the_draws():
    assert _actions(RandomPlayer(5, seed=7), 50, explore=True) == _actions(
        RandomPlayer(5, seed=7), 50, explore=False
    )


def test_different_seeds_give_different_actions():
    assert _actions(RandomPlayer(3, seed=0), 50) != _actions(RandomPlayer(3, seed=1), 50)


def test_every_action_is_drawn():
    assert set(_actions(RandomPlayer(4, seed=3), 200)) == {0, 1, 2, 3}


def test_learn_leaves_the_draws_unchanged():
    player = RandomPlayer(3, seed=2)
    t = Transition(
        obs=OBS,
        actions=np.zeros(1, dtype=np.int64),
        reward=np.ones(1, dtype=np.float32),
        next_obs=OBS,
        terminated=np.zeros(1, dtype=bool),
        active=np.ones(1, dtype=bool),
        truncated=False,
    )
    player.learn(t)
    assert _actions(player, 30) == _actions(RandomPlayer(3, seed=2), 30)


def test_save_then_load_replays_the_same_actions(tmp_path: Path):
    player = RandomPlayer(3, seed=4)
    _actions(player, 5)
    path = tmp_path / "random.json"
    player.save(path)
    first = _actions(player, 20)
    other = RandomPlayer(3, seed=99)
    other.load(path)
    assert _actions(other, 20) == first
